title: Life Among the Gorillas
cn: 第 17 集 · 大猩猩之中的生活
novel:
Marshall started work at a huge company and came home talking like an [[anthropologist|anthropologist]].

"I am not an employee," he said. "I am a scientist. I [[observe|observe]] them."

He began to [[document|document]] the [[behaviour|behaviour]] of his [[colleagues|colleague]] in a notebook. The office, he explained, was a [[habitat|habitat]]. His grey [[cubicle|cubicle]] was a nest. The men in suits moved in a [[pack|pack]] and defended their [[territory|territory]] near the coffee machine.

There was a clear [[hierarchy|hierarchy]]. The [[dominant|dominant]] male told loud jokes; the others [[grunted|grunt]] with laughter, even when nothing was funny. Every Friday they performed a strange [[ritual|ritual]] with beer and a [[howl|howl]] of "weekend!"

Their manners were [[primitive|primitive]] and sometimes [[aggressive|aggressive]], almost [[savage|savage]]. Marshall found the whole [[species|species]] fascinating.

Then, slowly, something happened. To [[blend in|blend in]] he began to [[imitate|imitate]] them. He wore the same tie. He told the same joke. His [[instinct|instinct]] for kindness went quiet.

One evening Lily looked at him and said, "You have started to [[adapt|adapt]]."

Marshall closed the notebook. The scientist, he realised, had become part of the [[tribe|tribe]].

anthropologist.en: a scientist who studies how people and cultures live

observe.en: to watch carefully to learn something

document.en: to write down facts so there is a record

behaviour.en: the way a person or animal acts

habitat.en: the natural place where an animal lives

cubicle.en: a small work space with low walls around it

pack.en: a group of animals that hunt together

territory.en: an area that an animal or person treats as its own

hierarchy.en: a system where some people are above others

dominant.en: strongest and most powerful in a group

grunt.en: to make a short low sound instead of speaking

ritual.en: the same actions done in the same way every time

howl.en: a long loud cry, like a wolf makes

primitive.en: very simple and from a very early time

species.en: one kind of animal or plant

blend in.en: to look the same as everyone else, so nobody notices you

imitate.en: to copy the way someone speaks or acts

instinct.en: a feeling that tells you what to do, without thinking

adapt.en: to change so you fit a new situation

tribe.en: a group of people who live and act together
